about.title: Villa Park Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Villa Park is a small place. With fewer than six thousand residents, a sudden death is felt on the whole street, not just in one home. Public records show the city's roads were quiet in 2025, with five injury collisions, eleven people hurt and no traffic fatalities, yet a wrongful death claim here can come from many directions: a crash on Santiago Boulevard or Villa Park Road, a fall at a business, a medical error at a nearby hospital, or a defective product. Under California law, a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children have the first right to bring the case, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The claim is civil, entirely separate from any criminal charges the county may pursue. Families can seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and compensation for the loss of love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Villa Park families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless your family recovers.

whyChoose.title: Why Villa Park Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Questions Sorted Early
items.desc: California limits who may file, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children. The attorney you are matched with will sort out who in your family qualifies before anything is filed.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock Is Watched
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is far shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting connected early protects that deadline.

items.title: Every Category of Loss Counted
items.desc: Recoverable losses go beyond funeral and burial costs to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. An independent attorney works to account for all of it, with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My relative died after a crash on Santiago Boulevard. Does the fact that Villa Park had no traffic deaths in 2025 affect our claim?
items.answer: No. Public collision counts describe a year, not your family's case. A wrongful death claim rests on whether another party's negligence caused the death, and the evidence gathered about that specific crash, on Santiago Boulevard or anywhere else in Villa Park, is what matters.

items.question: The driver who caused the death is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: You do not. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and proceeds on its own track, with its own two-year deadline that keeps running regardless of the criminal court schedule. Many families move forward with both at once, and the outcome of one does not decide the other.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file, and can more than one person join?
items.answer: California gives first standing to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and the children. If there are none, certain dependents and heirs may qualify. Eligible family members typically join in one action, and the attorney you are connected with can explain how that works for your situation.
